newsitem.title: USA: ADM units agree to monitor futures trading - CFTC.
newsitem.headline: ADM units agree to monitor futures trading - CFTC.

text.p: Two futures commission merchants owned by Archer Daniels Midland Co agreed to to review each week any trading done on behalf of ADM for compliance with U.S. futures laws, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Friday.

As part of a settlement with CFTC, the two firms, ADM Investor Services and Benson-Quinn Commodities Inc also promised to not employ anyone who was involved in the criminal misconduct that ADM pleaded guilty to last autumn.
On Oct 15, ADM admitted that it participated in a conspiracy to fix the prices of lysine and citric acide in the United States, and agreed to pay $100 million in fines.
Under federal commodities law, the futures registrations held by both firms are subject to suspension, revocation or restrictions because of ADM's felony price-fixing case/
In the settlement with the CFTC, ADM Investor Services and Benson-Quinn agreed to monitor and review each week all trading conducted on behalf of ADM.
